messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from Annexure to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 36):
"""
S No Item Particulars (to be filled by the Insurer) Tax Act, 1961 applicable for payment of taxes by the Insurer] 4.19 Any other parameter relevant to pricing of product –specify 4.20 Reserving assumptions (please specify all the relevant details) 4.21 Base rate (risk premium)- furnish the rate table, if any 4.22 Gross premium- furnish the rate table, if any 4.23 Expected loss ratio (for the product) -to be furnished for each plan offered within the product separately 4.24 Age-wise loss ratio- to be S.No Age Loss ratio furnished for each option or plan offered within the product separately 4.25 Sum insured-wise- loss ratio to be furnished for each option or plan offered within the product separately S.No SA Loss ratio 4.26 Age and sum insured wise loss ratio - to be furnished for each option or plan separately Table
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"What details must insurers provide about reserving assumptions for a health insurance product?","answer":"Insurers must specify all relevant details of reserving assumptions.","facts":["4.20 Reserving assumptions (please specify all the relevant details)"]},{"question":"What tables are required to be furnished by insurers for base rate and gross premium?","answer":"Insurers must furnish the rate table for base rate (risk premium) and for gross premium, if any.","facts":["4.21 Base rate (risk premium)- furnish the rate table, if any","4.22 Gross premium- furnish the rate table, if any"]}]}
